description: Fetch the currently rendered comments for one public Product Hunt launch. Compact output returns the launch summary and comment cards; detailed mode adds launch metadata, raw comment text, and thread identifiers. The verified comment page parameter is supported; unverified limit and sort inputs are intentionally not exposed.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: Required Product Hunt product slug, such as linear.

parameters.name: launch
parameters.description: Required launch slug under the product, such as linear-diffs.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Positive rendered comment page number; page 2 was verified.

parameters.name: detailed
parameters.description: Add launch metadata, raw comment text, and thread identifiers. Pass true or false.
